caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair positioned at a slight angle, showing both the front and side of the chair. The chair features curved rockers at the base, turned legs, and arm supports. The seat appears to be woven, possibly from cane or another material, with a rectangular shape. The backrest consists of four horizontal wooden slats, with the uppermost slat being wider and solid, while the middle two slats include evenly spaced wooden balls as decorative elements. The wood is illustrated in various shades of brown, with highlights and shadows suggesting a light source coming from the left. The background is plain, off-white, and bordered by a single, thin, rectangular outline near the edges of the paper. The artist’s signature, “Florence Truelson,” appears at the lower right inside the outline.
title: Colonial Rocking Chair
